title: Reka Edge: price, context window and specs
answer: Reka Edge is a model in Rekaai's Rekaai Reka family, first listed on 2026-03-20. It takes image, text and video in and returns text, with a context window of 16K tokens and up to 14K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.1 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as RekaAI/reka-edge-2603, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
compare: It is the newest of the 2 versions of Rekaai Reka listed today.
Its input price is the family median, $0.1 per million tokens.
